description: Inspect a candidate's layout and states, compare plausible choices, or show the person how a part looks. Returns one labelled states sheet in dark or light Prism and a public URL. Pictures of 🔒 elements are available too; their code still needs access. Choose pictures that resolve a design question rather than requesting the whole catalogue. This previews a library part, not the app you compose from it.

theme.description: Sheet theme; default dark. Both use the default Prism look.

name: beamline_picture
